prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Warehouse boundary: receiving to outbound load release. Elements: Inbound Inspection Desk (Cinderbay): checks paperwork, trailer ID/seals, records damage; sends Trailer Seal Exception Note. Pallet Dimension Scanner (Moonquarry): measures pallets; produces Oversize Load Advisory (never authorizes rule-failing placement); supports oversize routing. Inbound Pallet Buffer. North Aisle Stacker Crane (Juniperwake): sends Aisle Occupancy Snapshot, updated on change. South Aisle Stacker Crane. East/West Transfer Conveyors: interfaces between vehicle travel and outbound staging. Conveyor Line Controller (Brasshaven): sequences pallets per path; produces Transfer Induction Ticket per induction. Autonomous Forklift Fleet (Larkspur): produces Forklift Handoff Confirmation after transfer (vehicle ID, pallet ID, time, incomplete/deferred moves). Yard Gate Controller (Velvetrook): validates arrivals vs receiving plan, directs to lane then door, flags unscheduled. Outbound Dispatch Sorter: receives Dispatch Wave Amendment, applies authorized changes. Outbound Checkweigh Scale; Shipping Documentation Desk: shipment records from confirmed pallet/destination data. Safety Zone Controller; Fire Alarm Panel: produces Sprinkler Zone Inhibit Notice on fire-protection condition. Maintenance Release Terminal. Actors: Warehouse Operations Supervisor (exceptions, recovery, holds; reviews delays, abnormal stops, staging constraints before next wave release); drivers, receiving, yard staff. Warehouse Management System (Morrowglass): authoritative task/inventory/priority state; sends Dispatch Wave Amendment when destination/priority/sequence changes after wave prep; produces Slot Reservation Receipt; allocation, shipment windows, wave planning. Requirements: valid receipt instruction; door only when door/lane/crew free; count before unloading done; damaged pallets segregated; pause unloading on issues; clearances kept; cranes in authorized zones, valid targets; conveyor entry after inspection; interlocks; sensors confirm before transfer; blocked transfer holds upstream; merges one at a time; induction fields checked, duplicates held; stale snapshot holds path; post-fault resume preserving order; no move without WMS release; sorter keeps committed order unless amendment authorizes, verifies staging vs plan before loading; forklifts accept work only with valid status/area/path, pick tasks by priority/battery/proximity, route by aisle access/transfer readiness/pedestrian controls/restrictions, confirm pallet ID/location before lifting, limit speed/turns, stop/reroute when safety controls block; work requests need unique task reference, destination, constraints;

New part:
S128: Yard Gate Controller records unresolved discrepancies for review and prevents an affected vehicle from proceeding when the discrepancy creates an operating risk.
S129: Yard Gate Controller uses the exception note to manage a receiving discrepancy at the gate.
S130: The receiving exception remains visible to the Warehouse Operations Supervisor until the discrepancy has been assessed and resolved.
S131: Inbound Inspection Desk records inspection outcomes before pallets enter routine warehouse handling.
S132: Inbound Pallet Buffer provides a controlled staging point when inspection or downstream handling is not yet ready.
S133: Pallet Dimension Scanner supplies measurements used to identify pallets that require a different handling path.
S134: Conveyor Line Controller coordinates conveyor movement and stops affected equipment when a downstream condition prevents safe transfer.
S135: East Transfer Conveyor and West Transfer Conveyor provide separate routes for moving pallets between operating areas.
S136: Autonomous Forklift Fleet receives work only when a route and destination are available for the assigned vehicle.
S137: North Aisle Stacker Crane and South Aisle Stacker Crane report operating availability so task allocation can account for equipment status.
S138: The Warehouse Operations Supervisor can defer work when a route conflict, equipment fault, or staging constraint remains unresolved.
S139: Maintenance Release Terminal is also known as Copperfield.
S140: Maintenance Release Terminal produces the Crane Service Release Card after required maintenance checks have been completed.
S141: Maintenance authorization is recorded before affected equipment is returned to operational service.
S142: Morrowglass reconciles work across operating areas and preserves a consistent view of task status and outstanding constraints.
S143: Outbound Dispatch Sorter organizes completed pallets according to the current shipping plan.
S144: Outbound Checkweigh Scale verifies shipment weight before the shipping record is finalized.
S145: Shipping Documentation Desk prepares shipment records from confirmed pallet and destination data.
S146: Fire Alarm Panel and Safety Zone Controller provide safety status that can require movement to stop or be restricted.
S147: Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews delayed tasks, abnormal vehicle stops, and unresolved staging constraints before releasing the next outbound wave.
S148: Exception handling preserves a traceable hold state until the source of a discrepancy is understood and the affected pallet can be safely routed.
S149: A mismatch between expected and observed pallet attributes prevents automatic allocation and directs the load to controlled review.
S150: The operating record retains the scan result, location, and time of detection so that the review can be reconstructed.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
